title: Google Ads for Construction Companies - Ruban KT

facts.fact: Ruban KT's page says Google Ads lets construction firms start with as little as $15–$30 per day.
facts.quote: Google Ads offers flexible budgeting, allowing firms to start with as little as $15–$30/day.

facts.fact: Ruban KT's page states that construction clients often see a 3–4x return on ad spend (ROAS) within the first three months of Google Ads.
facts.quote: Construction clients often see 3–4x return on ad spend (ROAS) within the first three months.

facts.fact: Ruban KT's page says more than 40,000 searches per second happen on Google.
facts.quote: 40,000+ searches per second happen on Google, making keyword targeting critical.

facts.fact: Ruban KT's page states that construction companies using Google Search Ads often see conversion rates of 8–12%.
facts.quote: Construction companies using Google Search Ads often see conversion rates of 8–12%.

facts.fact: Ruban KT's page says the Google Display Network gives access to over 35 million websites and apps.
facts.quote: Access to over 35 million websites and apps.

facts.fact: Ruban KT's page claims display ads can increase brand awareness by up to 80%, without naming a source.
facts.quote: Display ads can increase brand awareness by up to 80%.

facts.fact: The Ruban KT article was published on August 1, 2025.
The vendor states that LSAs can generate 2.5x higher quality traffic than traditional search ads, with no source given.
facts.quote: LSAs can generate 2.5x higher quality traffic than traditional search ads.

facts.fact: The vendor states that businesses with LSAs often see a cost-per-lead between $100 and $300, depending on competition.
facts.quote: Businesses with LSAs often see a cost-per-lead between $100–$300, depending on competition.

facts.fact: The vendor states that YouTube reaches over 2 billion logged-in users monthly, with no source given.
facts.quote: YouTube reaches over 2 billion logged-in users monthly.

facts.fact: The vendor states that video ads can increase purchase intent by up to 97% when paired with remarketing, with no source given.
facts.quote: Video ads can increase purchase intent by up to 97% when paired with remarketing.

facts.fact: The vendor states that remarketing ads can boost conversion rates by up to 70%, with no source given.
facts.quote: Remarketing ads can boost conversion rates by up to 70%.

facts.fact: The vendor states that geo-specific local keywords improve ad relevance and conversion rates by up to 30%.
facts.quote: These improve ad relevance and conversion rates by up to 30%.

facts.fact: The vendor states that Target CPA can reduce cost-per-lead by up to 25% for lead-heavy campaigns.
facts.quote: For lead-heavy campaigns, Target CPA can reduce cost-per-lead by up to 25%.

facts.fact: The vendor states that landing pages that load in under 3 seconds see 32% higher conversions, with no source given.
facts.quote: Pages that load in under 3 seconds see 32% higher conversions.

facts.fact: The vendor states that 64% of construction-related searches happen on mobile devices, with no source given.
facts.quote: With 64% of construction-related searches happening on mobile devices

facts.fact: The vendor states that keywords such as "home renovation contractor" or "commercial builders near me" can cost $8–$15 per click.
facts.quote: can cost $8–$15 per click.

facts.fact: The vendor recommends starting with a daily budget of $15–$30 for small construction firms.
facts.quote: Start with a daily budget of $15–$30 for small firms.

facts.fact: The vendor's FAQ says contractors can start Google Ads with as little as $15–$30 per day.
facts.quote: Contractors can start with as little as $15–$30/day and scale based on ROI.

facts.fact: The vendor suggests targeting homeowners aged 30–55 in demographic targeting.
facts.quote: Target by age (30–55 for homeowners)

facts.fact: The vendor states that Google Keyword Planner is free and integrated with Google Ads.
facts.quote: Google Keyword Planner is free and integrated with Google Ads.
